No date suffix on the new IDs. Add au. or global. for cross-Region inference on bedrock-runtime; mantle takes the bare ID, in-region only.
Regional (au., in-region) costs ~10% more than global. Availability changes fast: check the Bedrock model card before you quote a customer.
